# Christian Pure

> Christian Pure (https://christianpure.com/) publishes Christian articles on prayer, Bible verses, Bible study, names in the Bible and church history, with free tools, courses and a weekly email. Every English article has a plain-text Markdown copy: add .md to its address, as in https://christianpure.com/learn/apostles-creed.md

You may quote articles and link to them. Articles appear in ten more languages at addresses such as https://christianpure.com/es/learn/...; the English address is the original. A read-only connector (MCP) for articles, prayers, Bible verses and courses needs no account: https://christianpure.com/wp-json/christianpure-connector/v1/mcp

## Start here

- [Prayers](https://christianpure.com/learn/category/prayers/): every prayer on the site, grouped by subject, with a search box
- [Bible Verses](https://christianpure.com/learn/category/bible-verses/): every Bible verse collection, grouped by subject
- [Topics](https://christianpure.com/topics/): all article subjects
- [Free tools](https://christianpure.com/free-tools/): every free tool; none needs an account
- [Interactive Bible](https://christianpure.com/interactive/): interactive Bible maps and original Greek and Hebrew words
- [Courses](https://christianpure.com/courses/): Bible courses
- [Editorial standards](https://christianpure.com/editorial-standards/): how articles are written, sourced and checked
- [Corrections](https://christianpure.com/corrections/): corrections made to articles
- [Our Mission](https://christianpure.com/about/): who runs Christian Pure and why

## Free tools

- [Find a Prayer for What You Are Facing](https://christianpure.com/find-a-prayer/): a prayer for what someone is facing
- [Prayer of the Day](https://christianpure.com/prayer-of-the-day/): a new prayer each day
- [Verse of the Day](https://christianpure.com/verse-of-the-day/): a new Bible verse each day
- [What Does the Bible Say About…?](https://christianpure.com/what-does-the-bible-say-about/): what the Bible says about a subject, verse by verse
- [Is That in the Bible?](https://christianpure.com/is-that-in-the-bible/): whether a well-known saying is in the Bible
- [Compare Christian Denominations](https://christianpure.com/compare-denominations/): what Christian denominations teach, question by question
- [Which Bible? A Bible Translation Comparison Chart](https://christianpure.com/bible-translation-chart/): Bible translations compared
- [When Is Easter? Church Year Dates](https://christianpure.com/when-is-easter/): dates of Easter and the church year for any year
- [Today in the Church](https://christianpure.com/today-in-the-church/): feasts and saints of the day
- [Find a saint](https://christianpure.com/saint-finder/): a saint by name, patronage or feast day
- [Biblical baby names](https://christianpure.com/biblical-baby-names/): Bible names and their meanings
- [Bible by the Numbers](https://christianpure.com/bible-by-the-numbers/): counts and figures about the Bible
- [How Long Does It Take to Read the Bible?](https://christianpure.com/how-long-does-it-take-to-read-the-bible/): reading time for the Bible and each book
- [Random Bible Verse Generator](https://christianpure.com/random-bible-verse/): a random Bible verse
- [Bedtime Prayer Builder](https://christianpure.com/bedtime-prayer-builder/): a bedtime prayer for a child
- [Advent Devotional: A Prayer for Each Day of Advent](https://christianpure.com/advent-devotional/): a prayer for each day of Advent
- [Bulletin covers and inserts for Sunday worship](https://christianpure.com/bulletin-inserts/): free bulletin inserts for Sunday worship
- [Hymns Newly Free to Print in 2027](https://christianpure.com/public-domain-hymns/): hymns that are free to print
- [Christian quizzes](https://christianpure.com/christian-quizzes/): Bible and faith quizzes
